blocks.text: BAGUIO CITY — A 62-year-old driver died while his three passengers were hurt after a van plunged into a 10-meter-deep ravine in the Benguet farming town of Atok on Wednesday. The accident occurred at 11:10 a.m. along Km. 38 in Barangay Abiang, but police were notified at about 1:40 p.m. Initial police investigation showed that the white van was traveling toward Benguet’s capital, La Trinidad, when the driver misjudged a curve on the mountain road and inadvertently struck a steel barrier on the right side of the highway before falling into the ravine.
